title: DOG-DPO:Dynamic Optimization in Geometry for Safety Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2606.07678v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Safety alignment for large language models relies on preference data, but current pipelines often train on large, redundant datasets. Existing data selection methods typically score each preference pair independently, collapsing directional preference information into scalar quality or diversity scores. This sample-centric view is especially limiting in multi-dataset settings, where shared safety directions coexist with dataset-specific residual risks. We propose DOG-DPO, a training-free data selection framework that treats preference pairs as structured geometric signals. DOG-DPO first represents each preference pair as a direction in model representation space. It then decomposes multi-dataset preference geometry into a global anchor subspace and dataset-specific residual subspaces. Finally, it selects subsets by maximizing diversity-based coverage, encouraging broad, non-redundant coverage of alignment directions before DPO

translated_title: DOG-DPO：面向安全对齐的几何动态优化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的安全对齐依赖于偏好数据，但当前的训练流程往往使用庞大且冗余的数据集。现有的数据选择方法通常独立地对每个偏好对进行打分，将方向性的偏好信息压缩为标量化的质量或多样性分数。这种以样本为中心的视角在多数据集场景下尤为受限，因为共享的安全方向与数据集特有的残余风险同时存在。我们提出了DOG-DPO，一个无需训练的数据选择框架，它将偏好对视为结构化的几何信号。DOG-DPO首先将每个偏好对表示为模型表示空间中的一个方向；然后将多数据集的偏好几何分解为全局锚定子空间和数据集特有的残余子空间；最后通过最大化基于多样性的覆盖度来选择子集，从而在DPO训练之前实现对安全对齐方向的广泛、非冗余的覆盖。
tldr: 提出无需训练的数据选择框架DOG-DPO，将偏好对视为模型表示空间中的几何方向，通过分解全局锚定子空间与数据集特有残余子空间并最大化多样性覆盖，为DPO安全对齐筛选出广泛且非冗余的偏好数据子集。
en_tdlr: DOG-DPO is a training-free data selection framework that treats preference pairs as geometric directions in model representation space, decomposes multi-dataset preference geometry into a global anchor subspace and dataset-specific residual subspaces, and selects diverse, non-redundant subsets by maximizing coverage for DPO-based safety alignment.
